title: General Material Blend 3-Mix Solo #30 (부채꼴·매끈 | 뱀비늘+금박+코이비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Chinese woman, an adult, in her early 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a serene expression, deep dark brown hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 50 studs piercings set with pearls in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of silver a hair ornament. Full body fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 57% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 10 o'clock, 4 o'clock and 8 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 3 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
